当你的应用需要通过蓝牙与外部设备通信时（如连接蓝牙耳机、音箱、键盘、鼠标，或与智能穿戴设备进行低功耗数据交换），可以使用蓝牙模块的相关API
当你的应用需要管理Wi-Fi连接（如连接网络、Wi-Fi直连传输文件、开启热点分享）或需要使用NFC功能（如读取NFC标签、实现门禁卡模拟、访问安全单元）时，可以使用WLAN或NFC模块
如果需要开发与伙伴设备互通的应用，可以使用融合短距服务接口
实现蓝牙设备自动重连并监听连接状态变化 / Implement Bluetooth device auto-reconnect and monitor connection state changes
扫描附近 BLE 外设并通过 GATT 读写特征值 / Scan nearby BLE peripherals and read/write characteristics over GATT
发布 BLE 广播让其他设备发现我的应用设备 / Advertise over BLE so other devices can discover my app device
用 RFCOMM/SPP 建立经典蓝牙串口通信并收发数据 / Build classic Bluetooth serial communication with RFCOMM/SPP and send/receive data
搜索可用 Wi‑Fi 热点并连接指定 SSID / Discover available Wi‑Fi networks and connect to a target SSID
监听 WLAN 网络状态变化并获取当前连接信息 / Listen for WLAN state changes and get current connection info
用 Wi‑Fi P2P 发现附近设备并建立点对点传输 / Discover nearby devices with Wi‑Fi P2P and establish peer-to-peer transfer
读取 NFC 标签内容并向标签写入文本或 URI / Read NFC tag content and write text or URI records to a tag
接入 HCE 实现门禁卡或会员卡模拟 / Integrate HCE to emulate an access card or membership card
在前台感应 NDEF 标签并处理碰一碰交互 / Handle foreground NDEF tag discovery for tap interactions
管理蓝牙配对设备列表并发起配对解绑 / Manage the bonded Bluetooth device list and trigger pair/unpair actions
获取本机蓝牙和 Wi‑Fi 开关状态并引导用户开启 / Get local Bluetooth and Wi‑Fi power states and guide users to enable them
do_not_use_when: 需求是使用 URPC 远程调用、请求缓存、拦截器、流式传输或断点续传下载上传；应改用 remote-communication-kit / The requirement is URPC remote invocation, request caching, interceptors, streaming transfer, or resumable upload/download; use remote-communication-kit instead
preconditions: 应用已在 module.json5 中声明所需权限，并完成对应能力申请 / Required permissions are declared in module.json5 and the corresponding capabilities are requested
目标设备硬件与系统版本支持所用的蓝牙、WLAN 或 NFC 能力 / The target device hardware and system version support the Bluetooth, WLAN, or NFC capability being used
涉及受保护操作时，用户已授予运行时权限且相应系统开关已开启（如蓝牙、Wi-Fi、NFC） / For protected operations, runtime permissions are granted and the relevant system switches are enabled (such as Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, or NFC)
inputs: 通信类型与模式 / communication type and mode
目标设备标识或扫描条件 / target device identifier or scan criteria
连接参数或会话配置 / connection parameters or session configuration
待发送数据、标签负载或读写内容 / data to send, tag payload, or read/write content

postconditions.statement: 代码已接入所选短距通信能力的相关 API，并围绕蓝牙、WLAN 或 NFC 建立正确调用流程 / The code integrates the relevant APIs for the chosen proximity communication capability and builds the correct call flow around Bluetooth, WLAN, or NFC
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set add or modify code to call HarmonyOS Bluetooth, WLAN, or NFC APIs in a way that matches the user's requested capability?

postconditions.statement: 工程已补充该能力所需的权限声明、能力配置或前后台读写/连接相关注册项（如适用） / The project includes the required permission declarations, capability configuration, or foreground/background read-write or connection-related registrations where applicable
postconditions.judge_prompt: By inspecting the edits, are the necessary module.json5 entries, permissions, or related capability configuration added or updated for the selected connectivity feature?

postconditions.statement: 已处理关键结果路径，包括扫描/连接/读写的成功与失败分支或状态监听 / The key result paths are handled, including success and failure branches or state listeners for scanning, connecting, or reading/writing
postconditions.judge_prompt: Do the edits include callbacks, promise handling, event listeners, or equivalent logic for both normal and error/state-change handling of the connectivity operation?
